faqItems.question: How can I schedule an appointment at the Palani Center?
faqItems.answer: Scheduling is easy. You can call the office directly at (310) 894-8337 or use the online appointment request form available on the website.

faqItems.question: What should I expect during my first visit?
faqItems.answer: You can expect a comprehensive consultation where Dr. Giri Palani will assess your dental health, discuss concerns, and create a personalized treatment plan.

faqItems.question: How long does a dental implant procedure take?
faqItems.answer: The duration typically ranges from one to two hours, depending on the complexity of the case and the number of implants being placed.

faqItems.question: Are there financing options for my treatment?
faqItems.answer: Yes, the center offers flexible payment plans and assists in exploring third-party financing options to make procedures more affordable.

faqItems.question: What sedation options are available?
faqItems.answer: Options include local anesthesia, nitrous oxide (laughing gas), and oral or IV sedation for a comfortable experience tailored to your needs.

faqItems.question: Do you handle dental emergencies?
faqItems.answer: Yes, the Palani Center prioritizes dental emergencies by offering prompt and compassionate care to alleviate pain and restore health.

clinic.footerAbout: Palani Center for Dental Implants provides advanced dental implant solutions and cosmetic dentistry to the Rancho Palos Verdes community with a focus on compassion and clinical excellence.

doctor.name: Giri Palani
doctor.bio: Dr. Giri Palani is a highly qualified dental professional specializing in advanced dental implant solutions and cosmetic dentistry. With years of experience and extensive training, he is dedicated to restoring oral health, function, and esthetics for every patient. His commitment to ongoing education ensures he stays at the forefront of modern dental technology, including 3D imaging and computer-guided surgery. Dr. Palani combines clinical skill with genuine compassion to create a stress-free experience for his guests.
